title: About Us
body_md:
## Who We Are

XLmarket (Roland Kaubandus OÜ) is an Estonian e-commerce company with over 25 years of experience in trade and e-commerce, specialising in professional tools, workshop and garage equipment, garden and agricultural machinery, catering equipment, and renewable-energy solutions.

## Why Choose XLmarket

**Experience you can rely on.** A quarter of a century of trading has taught us that customer trust is earned with every single order.

**Clear information in Estonian.** Every product has an Estonian description and technical details so you can choose with confidence.

**Easy to find.** We have carefully organised the catalogue so every product sits in a logical place and search finds it even in your own words.

**Secure payment.** Pay through a familiar Estonian bank, safely and quickly.

**Fast delivery across Estonia.** Your order reaches you quickly and reliably.

**Outlet: quality for less.** Products with opened or damaged packaging are offered at a noticeably lower price, each clearly labelled so you know exactly what you are buying.

**Your rights are protected.** All purchases carry a 14-day right of withdrawal and the statutory 24-month right to submit a claim for product defects.
